description: Per-run context every agent, tool and workflow reads: tenant, caller, effective permissions and regional settings.

activeScreen.description: Route id of the UI screen the caller is on.

aiMode.description: Whether models are real providers or the deterministic fakes.

conversationId.description: Chat conversation id; also the memory thread id.

currency.description: Default ISO 4217 currency of the active node.

displayTimeZone.description: IANA time zone used to show dates to the caller.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for answers and formatting.

nodeTimeZone.description: IANA time zone of the active node, for calendar rules.

organizationId.description: Same value as tenantId; the key Mastra TokenCostControl reads.

permissions.description: Effective permissions: principal grants intersected with the agent ceiling.

principalKind.description: Whether a person or an API key made the call.

projectId.description: Active project, when the request is scoped to one.

tenantId.description: Active organization; from the verified principal, never from the client body.

unitId.description: Active unit, when the request is scoped to one.

userId.description: Firebase Auth uid of the caller (API key owner for services).
